title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance
facebook: Ever wonder how ads show up in ChatGPT without messing up your answers? OpenAI built a system that uses the AI itself to understand what you're looking for — and keeps ads in a separate lane so they don't muddy your results. Here's how it works. https://aiworldhq.com/article/how-chatgpt-s-new-ad-system-tries-to-keep-ads-separate-from-answers #ChatGPT #Privacy
